facts.value: A Bachelor's degree in Southeast Asian Studies or comparable disciplines at Goethe University with a standard programme duration of at least 6 semesters, or a degree of at least equivalent value from a German university or German institute of higher education in a similar or related discipline with a standard programme duration of at least 6 semesters, or a degree of at least equivalent value from a foreign university in a similar or related discipline with a standard programme duration of at least 6 semesters, or a Bachelor's degree in another discipline in the humanities or social sciences with a standard programme duration of at least 6 semesters.
facts.original_value: a) A Bachelor's degree in Southeast Asian Studies or comparable disciplines at Goethe University with a standard programme duration of at least 6 semesters, or b) a degree of at least equivalent value from a German university or German institute of higher education in a similar or related discipline with a standard programme duration of at least 6 semesters (see 2), or c) a degree of at least equivalent value from a foreign university in a similar or related discipline with a standard programme duration of at least 6 semesters (see 2), or d) a Bachelor's degree in another discipline in the humanities or social sciences with a standard programme duration of at least 6 semesters (see 2).

facts.value: In addition, a detailed CV providing information about the applicant's interest in the Southeast Asian Studies programme must be handed in with the application.
facts.original_value: e) In addition: Detailed CV providing information about the applicant's interest in the Southeast Asian Studies programme must be handed in with the application.

facts.value: Admission to the programme can be allowed by the Examination Committee for degrees of equivalent value, provided the applicant has an adequate command of Bahasa Indonesia (or Bahasa Malaysia) and a general familiarity with the Southeast Asian region. The Committee may impose conditions for foreign-discipline applicants, such as additional Indonesian language courses or additional seminars on languages and cultures of Southeast Asia.
facts.original_value: (2) In cases b), c), and d) admission to the programme can be allowed by the Examination Committee - provided the applicant has an adequate command of Bahasa Indonesia (or Bahasa Malaysia) and a general familiarity with the Southeast Asian region. The Examination Committee reserves the right to impose conditions for foreign-discipline applicants, such as additional Indonesian language courses or additional seminars on languages and cultures of Southeast Asia.

facts.value: The language of instruction for the Master's programme is English. The programme can be studied completely in English.
facts.original_value: (3) In general, the language of instruction for the Master's programme is English. As the programme can be studied completely in English...

facts.value: It is nevertheless preferable to have a basic knowledge of German language, since much relevant information is available in German only.
facts.original_value: Applicants for the programme should be made aware that it is nevertheless preferable to have a basic knowledge of German language, since in- and outside the university much relevant information is available in German only.
